ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark gray and black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity (white) contiguous zones occupy the distal sections of both the left and right lobes. These are bisected by a low-intensity (black) vertical band at the peduncle connection. Numerous low-intensity circular blobs are scattered within the white distal zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 42 degrees and a depth of roughly 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration with irregular peak-to-valley amplitudes ranging from 4 to 15 pixels across the entire trailing edge span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending toward the distal tips, which curve sharply upward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple discrete low-intensity circular pixel clusters (approx. 8-12 clusters per lobe) localized on the high-intensity white distal regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Visible set of parallel, near-vertical dark linear pixel disruptions located on the medial-right lobe, crossing the transition from light to dark pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring (rosettes) on both lobes and distinct vertical rake marks on the inner-right lobe surface.
